chunks: Muhammad ibn Ya'qub narrated from a number of our companions, from Sahl ibn Ziyad, from Ahmad ibn Muhammad ibn Abi Nasr, from Hammad ibn 'Uthman, from Isحاق ibn 'Ammar, who said:

I asked Abu al-Hasan (peace be upon him) about a slave boy of mine who jumped upon a female slave of mine and impregnated her, so she gave birth, and we needed her milk. I had declared permissible for them what they had done. Is the milk good (pure)? He said: Yes.

key_terms.ع: Peace be upon him (abbreviation for Imam)

ai.seo_question: Is the milk of a concubine who bears a child from a slave boy considered pure for drinking?
ai.summary: This hadith from *Al-Istibsar* clarifies the fiqh of *laban al-zina* (milk of zina), establishing that the milk of a female slave who bears a child from her master's slave boy is pure for consumption. Although the union is technically illicit (*zina*) due to the master's ownership of both parties, Imam al-Sadiq (AS) confirms the milk's purity, resolving a key point of contention in Shia jurisprudence regarding the status of offspring and bodily fluids in slave-master relationships.
